title: ID0473694-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP/SD170004262] Charger Not Accepting OCPP Load Management Values
description:

Solution: colleagues fault, they removed the port and modbusport from Outlet configuration - ticket to R&D: TS2RD-52

additional_info.subject: ID0473694-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP/SD170004262] Charger Not Accepting OCPP Load Management Values CRM:00263000380
additional_info.body:
Hi Johannes, good afternoon.
I checked this charger and I found something very odd. So this started at 8th January at around 4pm CET, the very same logs you sent in attachment of the DC outlet not found.
Right before this instances, I see that someone made a Change Configuration on the SiD that caused this, due to the fact that they removed the ports of the outlets:
2026-01-08T15:34:17.079283+00:00 [FW080104G2] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/7545bd1884d1[790]: Configuration-Backend configuration (configurations/set) changed: {"id":"wWiBsq","key":"outlets","value":[{"outletType":"ccs","outletId":1,"outletGroupId":1,"outletNumber":1,"authRequired":true,"authMethods":["rfid","qrcode"],"ocppAppAuthUrl":"https://omv.beenergised.cloud/infrastructure/direct_payment/process/start?evseid=AT*CRT*EA8678DC6517","ledChannel":1,"ip":"10.20.17.101","
port":null,"modbusPort":null
},{"outletType":"ccs","outletId":2,"outletGroupId":1,"outletNumber":2,"authRequired":true,"authMethods":["rfid","qrcode"],"ocppAppAuthUrl":"https://omv.beenergised.cloud/infrastructure/direct_payment/process/start?evseid=AT*CRT*EA8678DC6518","ledChannel":2,"ip":"10.20.17.100",
"port":null,"modbusPort":null
}],"operation":"","section":""}
As such, this seems like a bad configuration from someone. Obviously, in the logs it doesn't mention who did it, but the fact is there and after this was changed, the error was no longer present and the SmartCharging is again working as intended.
Please let me know your feedback before closing the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
